dlinear.parameterization: last-value-anchored linear residual paths for seasonal and trend decompositions

model_spec.input: univariate standardized causal history plus per-origin causal state features

linear_residual.history_projection_definition: last 96 normalized differences padded left when needed
linear_residual.mapping: single affine linear map from projected history and phi_t to residual path

m3_shuffle.meaning: breaks the pairing between each history and its state feature vector while retaining both marginal distributions
m3_shuffle.permutation: fixed split-specific NumPy PCG64 permutation seeded by run seed plus 9001

amendment.correction: Freeze the final real matrix after the corrected export implementation is in place. Retain all partial v1.6 real artifacts, task manifests, data, and lock under explicit mismatch labels; do not combine them with v1.7 results.
amendment.reason: v1.0-v1.5 corrections are retained in their archived locks. v1.6 began real runs after a complete lock, but the compact synthetic export subsequently corrected its protocol-lock mapping. Because task manifests intentionally hash the complete SAPR implementation, including the export script, v1.6 real tasks would contain two code hashes. No complete v1.6 real matrix was produced.

context_baselines.dlinear: learned contextual baseline with the same input length, maximum horizon, seed set, optimizer, early stopping, and training samples as M1-M3
context_baselines.seasonal_naive: available only when the configured period P is no longer than the causal input history

statistical_selection.fit_failure_fallback: persistence for that origin, with failure retained in failures.csv
statistical_selection.selection_metric: mean path RMSE on at most 20 fixed non-overlapping validation origins per series

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm across H1, H2, stable safety at four horizons

state_features.change_score: max(abs(latest_level_z), abs(first_difference_z), abs(second_difference_z), abs(short_trend_z), volatility_ratio, max_abs_jump_z, abs(seasonal_deviation_z))
state_features.missing_rule: never use a future value; windows with unresolved values are ineligible

protocol.study_scope: S-only causal persistence-residual forecasting; no external covariates or historical financial release inputs

real_panels.download_policy: download only listed original sources; record URL, retrieval time, raw SHA-256, license evidence and source metadata before preprocessing

beijing_air_quality.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), verified from source page 2026-10-02
beijing_air_quality.target_rule: PM2.5 for every station passing deterministic quality rules; meteorological variables excluded

electricity.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), verified from source page 2026-10-02
electricity.target_rule: all user load columns passing deterministic quality rules; hash-order cap at 100

ett.license: Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivatives 4.0 International (CC BY-ND 4.0), verified from repository LICENSE 2026-10-02; raw and processed data remain local and are not redistributed
ett.target_rule: OT only; no other sensor is input

quality_rules.long_gap_handling: mark all histories or targets crossing the gap ineligible
quality_rules.roster_order: SHA-256 of source-specific series identifier ascending
quality_rules.scaling: mean and standard deviation fit on each series training range only (ddof=0)

synthetic.stress_control: future-only jumps are omitted from primary pooled analysis and are not generated by this version
